fare_dispute.headline: Formal Appeal: Contested Fare Discrepancy and Account Restatement
fare_dispute.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am writing to formally contest the fare adjustment or suspension placed on my driver account regarding the trip completed on {date} at approximately {time} along the route {location}. The recorded fare does not accurately reflect the actual journey completed, M-Pesa records, or trip duration.

I request an immediate administrative review of the attached trip telemetry and payment receipts to adjust the fare and restore full account access.

passenger_safety.headline: Formal Appeal: Response to Safety Incident Allegation
passenger_safety.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am submitting this formal response regarding the safety incident report logged on {date} at {time} near {location}. I maintain a clean safety record and deny any misconduct during this trip.

Attached please find supporting dashcam footage, support chat logs, and relevant official documentation verifying the events as they occurred.

rating_or_cancellation.headline: Formal Appeal: Review of Unfair Rating and Cancellation Flag
rating_or_cancellation.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am requesting a review of the recent account flag/suspension resulting from a disputed rating or cancellation on {date} at {time} in {location}.

The trip status and passenger communications demonstrate that standard protocol was followed. Attached evidence confirms my rating history and trip context.

fraud_flag.headline: Formal Appeal: Clarification on Algorithmic Fraud Accusation
fraud_flag.body_template:
Dear {platform} Support Team,

I am writing to appeal the automated fraud flag applied to my account on {date} regarding activity near {location}.

My location history logs and M-Pesa transaction records confirm legitimate account activity without platform rule violations. I request human review and immediate account reactivation.
